description: Read the dead meters at the Threshold, then the dead meters up at Plaza North, and copy down numbers no one will ever check. 10₵.
name: Meter Reading

objectives.desc: Read the meters at the Threshold
objectives.emote: {who} crouches by the meter box and squints at the dial like it owes money.

objectives.desc: Read the meters at Plaza North
objectives.emote: {who} jots a number off the meter, taps the glass twice, and writes down a different number instead.
